WELCOME TO THE WORKSHOP

Build it. Drive it. Refine it.

01

Shape your circuit

Drag the orange points to reshape a layout. The pen adds a point to the nearest section. Start from scratch to click out your own circuit; three points close the loop. The eraser removes a point.

02

Make it yours

Adjust road width, smooth your corners, and choose a car. Use the flag tool to move the start line. Save circuits to your browser or export them from My circuits.

03

Find the limit

Hit Test drive. Use WASD or arrow keys to steer, accelerate, brake, and reverse. Space pauses; R resets the car. Complete a full lap in the arrow’s direction to set a time.

On a touch screen, use the steering and pedal buttons. Circuits and lap records are saved on this device.
